intro.headline: Upcoming Nights at Disco Dingo
intro.text: From themed roller-discos to guest DJ residencies flown in straight from the height of the disco revival, there’s a reason to put your dancing shoes on nearly every night of the week. Grab a ticket, round up your crew, and we’ll see you on the floor.

event1.title: Neon Nights: Guest DJ Starlight Sequin
event1.description: A three-hour set of classic disco and nu-disco imports, with a neon face-paint station on arrival and a confetti drop at midnight.

event2.title: Studio Dingo: A Tribute to the Golden Age
event2.description: Disco Dingo’s own tribute night to the legendary clubs of the late seventies — velvet ropes optional, glitter mandatory.

event3.title: Family Roller-Disco Matinee
event3.description: An afternoon session for all ages — skates available for hire, family-friendly playlist, and the mirror ball turned down to a gentler shimmer.

event4.title: Motown & Soul Thursdays
event4.description: A weekly midweek reset with the deepest soul and Motown cuts in the crate, hosted by our longest-serving resident DJ, Marvin Mirrorball.

event5.title: The Boogie Wonderland Ball
event5.description: Our biggest party of the season — full costume encouraged, live horn section for the first hour, and a mirror ball the size of a small car.
